subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add an N-turn model lease as core session state, and should it build on the one-turn override work or a separate `/model --turns` plus config contract?
rationale: The request is useful but creates public command, config, protocol, session-state, and provider-routing semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Build on one-turn override first
options.body: Land or settle the one-turn model override API, then layer N-turn accounting and revert notifications on that canonical mechanism.

options.title: Add full N-turn lease now
options.body: Specify `/model --turns`, per-model limits, warning thresholds, persistence, and revert behavior as a single core feature.

options.title: Decline core limits for now
options.body: Keep cost governance outside core until model override/session APIs are more stable or a plugin/API seam can own it.

recommendation.title: Build on one-turn override first
recommendation.body: Land or settle the one-turn model override API, then layer N-turn accounting and revert notifications on that canonical mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: The current inspected model/session code and recent PR provenance most directly route through this area.
